task.title: Inspect and prune path-index cache safely
task.problem: Versioned indexes accumulate and corrupt entries currently require manual rebuild flags; cache scope is opaque.
task.proposal: Add offline cache size/entry inspection and explicit prune/rebuild actions. Consider corruption fallback only with a visible diagnostic and no silently lost matches.
acceptance: Inspection shows version, digest, entry count and disk footprint.
Pruning does not remove in-use temporary indexes or unrelated caches.
Concurrent writers and corrupt/truncated indexes have regression coverage.
